title: Alchemical Scarab Ritual
description: Two hooded figures sit at a wooden table performing a ritual with a large glowing scarab beetle at the center. The stone wall behind them is covered with framed astronomical charts, constellation maps, and mystical diagrams, with golden rings, an open book, and floating orbs on the table.
prompt: Two hooded alchemists in white robes sit across from each other at a wooden table in a stone chamber, performing a ritual with a large glowing scarab beetle between them that emits golden light and orbs, golden rings and an open arcane book on the table, the brick wall behind covered with many framed astronomical charts, constellation maps, moon phases and mystical diagrams, detailed ink linework with splatters, dark fantasy atmosphere
